Rae: Quick run-through: enterprise customers want a "forensics" view for model rollouts — cost delta, error spike drilldowns, and a reliably linkable trace to disputed requests.
Tom: We should offer three scoped deliveries so leadership can pick tradeoffs.
Adi: Option 1 (light): show aggregated cost + error deltas by model_variant with a link to filtered traces (no token mapping). Fast, low runtime risk.
Sophie: Option 2 (hybrid): propagate hashed_tenant and model_variant into runtime and capture sampled token-level spans for flagged tenants. Medium risk, enables billing disputes.
Adi: Option 3 (complete): full per-token attribution across caching, batching, cross-region reroutes. High engineering cost; needs kernel benchmarking and SLO safeguards.
Rae: Acceptance notes: privacy-first (hash tenant IDs), CSV export for finance, rollout toggles per-tenant, and canary window.
infra-bot: perf job queued id perf-9910 ETA 72h.
Tom: Let's put MID as default ask for sales packaging; present tradeoffs Wed 10am. Owners: Adi (runtime), Sophie (UI), Tom (GTM).
